name: Adult speech therapy
summary: How expats access adult speech therapy in Singapore — accent coaching vs clinical therapy, post-stroke / voice pathways, and AHPC-registered therapists.
body:
Adult speech therapy covers clinical needs (voice, stuttering, post-stroke communication) and, separately, elective accent coaching. Do not confuse the two when booking — credentials and goals differ.

## Decision points
- Clinical speech-language therapy vs accent coaching
- Voice strain from teaching / call-centre work
- Post-stroke or neurological rehab pathways
- Telehealth follow-ups while travelling
- Insurance / hospital day-rehab coverage

Bring prior ENT or neurology letters when relevant.

## How to choose
Prefer AHPC-registered speech therapists for clinical care. Ask about assessment length and home practice load. For accent coaching, request a sample lesson plan tied to workplace scenarios.

## Practical tip
Record a 60-second work voicemail before session one. Progress is easier to hear than to feel week to week.
